from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial data extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company in the financial report")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    operating_cash_flow_net_amount: float = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities, the raw numerical value")
    currency: str = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount, e.g., '元'")
    source_table: str = Field(description="The specific table or section in the report where this value was found")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_records: list[CashFlowRecord]
